meta.what: R0 — the ENGINE-ARGUMENT ORACLE for the TriangularMultiplication refactor.
meta.why: The refactor is components-wiring: it may change WHO computes a config value, never WHAT it resolves to. So the deliverable is argument identity, and this file is what that is checked against. Every later step re-captures and diffs field-by-field.
